summary: Add one shared resolver for user-defined types over basic kinds and route the bool/string, number and duration conversion families (separate files) through it.

provenance.note: Evaluator-only. base_sha is the parent of the first of the two upstream commits that implement this change; neither is reachable from the sealed clone.
provenance.reference_patch: git diff --binary 633e5d0..9ffddd4 (new alias.go helper, wiring in basic.go/number.go/time.go, upstream tests; unchanged)
provenance.class_note: Upstream calls this 'alias resolution'. It is classified as a cross-file refactor because the prompt asks for a single shared resolver threaded through the default branch of four conversion paths in three files, and the hidden tests check every family.
provenance.dependency_cache: The module requires github.com/frankban/quicktest (test-only). Runs need the Go module proxy or a warm module cache.
provenance.size_note: about 1.7k non-test Go lines at base

reference.note: Evaluator-only. The verifier renders the reference patch from upstream: git diff --binary -M base_sha commit -- paths, per step.
